Name: Binning Skill Vanilla Retexture
Author: steevejr
Description:
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14073]
[/url]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/TxMW9y6.png[/img]

I love the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14073]Binning Skill [/url]﻿mod, but I wanted more vanilla-flavored trash cans in town. So I went ahead and made some myself.

The Recycling Bin craftable is now the green trashcan, the Trash Bin the steel, and the Composter is a wooden barrel or crate. I also retextured the grilled cheese and fish casserole for fun. I didn't touch the regular, copper, or steel trash cans or coordinating hats. The recycling machine is also unchanged.

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/FYgYWC8.png[/img]

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/jPCwpsB.png[/img]

You have two options for the ﻿Composter: Barrel or Crate.
Pick [b]one[/b], and delete the other file.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/X8CQxJp.png[/img]

I've also made desaturated versions of the trashcans. Hopefully they'll match most soft recolors.

[spoiler][img]https://i.imgur.com/mJnIIEO.png[/img]
[i][/i]
[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/T4lPmWo.png[/img]

You'll have to overwrite the files manually.
Copy over the .png images in my download to the same place in the BinningSkill and [CP] BinningSkill folders.
Pick either the barrel or the crate version and rename the file items.png.
Allow my images to overwrite.

Let me know if I made a mistake, or if you have any other recolor requests. Have fun!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7yd55k2.png[/img]
